verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I don’t know how to say exactly how I feel
I can’t begin to tell You what Your love has meant
I’m lost for words

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Is there a way to show the passion in my heart?
Can I express how truly great I think You are
My dearest Friend
Lord, this is my desire to pour my love on You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Like oil upon Your feet, like wine for You to drink
Like water from my heart I pour my love on You
If praise is like perfume, I’ll lavish mine on You
’Til every drop is gone, I’ll pour my love on You

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
Rightly do we love You
Son of God, Son of Man
Rightly do we love You, Jesus

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
You washed our robes in the blood of the Lamb
Rightly do we love You, Jesus

verse.name: o2a
verse.lines:
You are the alabaster jar
Broken for us
You are the pure anointing oil
Cleansing our sins
You are the costly perfume
Poured out on us
We love the fragrance of Your love

verse.name: o2b
verse.lines:
Fill me with the fragrance of Christ
Let a soothing aroma arise
A pleasing sacrifice for You
